top_signals.title: ECB Attacks Finland’s Bid to Make Bank Supervisors Target Growth
top_signals.summary: The European Central Bank is taking aim at Finland’s plan to require supervisors to promote growth and competition among lenders, warning that the change risks blurring their core responsibility for keeping banks safe and sound.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
